The corrected exponents for \(M\) are:

\[
M = 2^{30} \times 3^{13} \times 5^5 \times 7^3
\]

For each prime exponent \(e\), the number of choices for an even exponent in a square divisor is \(\lfloor e/2 \rfloor + 1\).

\[
(30 \to 16),\quad (13 \to 7),\quad (5 \to 3),\quad (3 \to 2)
\]

Thus the number of square divisors is

\[
16 \times 7 \times 3 \times 2 = 672
\]

\[
\boxed{672}
\]
